HEALTH CARE POWER OF ATTORNEY

I, Helena Margaret Osgood, of Mecklenburg County, North Carolina, born June 4, 1958, appoint the health care agent named below to make health care decisions for me.

1. MY HEALTH CARE AGENT

Name: Tobias Osgood-Reyes
Address: 1902 Sardis Road, Charlotte, North Carolina 28270
Telephone: (704) 555-0121
Relationship to me: son

2. ALTERNATE AGENTS

If my agent is unwilling, unable, or unavailable to act, I appoint, in this order:

First alternate: Priya Raghunathan Osgood, 88 Elm Row, Charlotte, North Carolina 28203, (704) 555-0177, daughter-in-law.
Second alternate: Cormac Osgood, 415 Wendover Road, Charlotte, North Carolina 28211, (704) 555-0192, brother.

3. WHEN MY AGENT'S AUTHORITY BEGINS

My agent's authority begins when my attending physician determines in writing that I lack the capacity to make or communicate my own health care decisions, and ends when I regain that capacity.

4. WHAT MY AGENT MAY DO

My agent may consent to, refuse, or withdraw consent to any care, treatment, service, or procedure to maintain, diagnose, or treat a physical or mental condition, including the giving or withholding of artificial nutrition and hydration and of cardiopulmonary resuscitation. My agent may choose and discharge my physicians and other providers, may consent to my admission to or discharge from a hospital, nursing home, hospice, or other facility, and may authorize an autopsy or an anatomical gift.

My agent is my personal representative for the purposes of the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act and 45 C.F.R. Parts 160 and 164, and may request, receive, and review any information, oral or written, about my physical or mental health, including medical and hospital records, and may consent to its disclosure.

5. LIMITS ON MY AGENT'S AUTHORITY

My agent may not consent to psychosurgery, sterilization, or admission to a facility for the treatment of mental illness against my objection. My agent may not withhold or withdraw life-prolonging measures if I am pregnant and the measures could allow the child to develop to live birth.

6. MY WISHES

I direct my agent to follow my wishes as I have expressed them here and in any advance directive I have signed. If my wishes are unknown, my agent shall act in my best interest, considering my values and my known beliefs. If my attending physician determines that I have an incurable and irreversible condition that will result in my death within a relatively short time, or that I am unconscious and my physician determines that to a high degree of medical certainty I will never regain consciousness, I direct that life-prolonging measures be withheld or discontinued, and that I be given care to keep me comfortable and free of pain.

7. NOMINATION OF GUARDIAN

If a guardian of my person is to be appointed, I nominate my agent to serve.

8. REVOCATION

I revoke any health care power of attorney I have signed before today. I may revoke this power of attorney at any time by any means that communicates my intent to revoke.

9. EFFECT OF A COPY

A copy of this document has the same effect as the original.

SIGNATURE

I sign this Health Care Power of Attorney on June 12, 2026. I am at least 18 years old, of sound mind, and acting freely and voluntarily.

______________________________
Helena Margaret Osgood

WITNESSES

Each of us declares that the principal signed this document in our presence, that the principal appears to be of sound mind and under no duress, fraud, or undue influence, that neither of us is related to the principal by blood or marriage, that neither of us would inherit from the principal under any will or by operation of law, that neither of us is the principal's attending physician or an employee of that physician, and that neither of us is the agent named above.
